claim_text_zh: 陈淳，字道复（亦作道復），号白阳山人，南直隶苏州府（今江苏苏州）人。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun, courtesy name Daofu, art name Baiyang Shanren (Mountain Man of White Sun), was from Suzhou, Nanzhili.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳生于成化十九年（1483年），卒于嘉靖二十三年（1544年），享年约六十一岁。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun was born in 1483 and died in 1544, aged approximately 61 sui.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳出身苏州官宦富室之家。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun was born into a wealthy Suzhou scholar-official family.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳初从文徵明学习书法，后与文徵明风格决裂，自创水墨写意画法。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun initially studied calligraphy under Wen Zhengming, then broke with Wen's style to develop his own expressive ink-wash method.
review_note: Break with Wen Zhengming is well-attested in art history; exact nature (personal vs. artistic) disputed.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳与徐渭并称'白阳青藤'，被视为明代写意花鸟画两大宗师。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun and Xu Wei are paired as 'Baiyang and Qingteng,' the two great masters of Ming freehand flower painting.
review_note: Reception/later art-historical grouping. '白阳青藤' is a retrospective label.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳擅长花鸟画与山水画，尤以水墨写意花鸟著称。画风受米芾影响。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun excelled in bird-and-flower and landscape painting, especially freehand ink-wash flowers, influenced by Mi Fu of the Song dynasty.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳传世作品包括《云雾山图》（1535年，弗利尔美术馆）、《雾山寻隐图》（克利夫兰美术馆）、《梅花水仙图》（普林斯顿大学美术馆）、《夏日庭院图》（约1530年，大都会美术馆）等。
claim_text_en: Surviving works include Mountains in Clouds (1535, Freer Gallery), Looking for a Monastery in the Misty Mountains (Cleveland Museum of Art), Narcissus and Plum Blossoms (Princeton), and Summer Garden (c. 1530, Metropolitan Museum).
review_note: Works verified by museum accession records.

claim_text_zh: 台北故宫博物院藏有陈淳多件作品，包括《重阳风雨图》《江流澄碧图》《崑璧图》《桐下鼓琴图》《五鹿图》。
claim_text_en: The National Palace Museum, Taipei, holds multiple Chen Chun works including Chongyang Fengyu Tu and Tongxia Guqin Tu.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳的名字在西文著录中亦作Chen Shun（陈顺），实为同一人，因'淳'字方言或异读所致。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun is also recorded as 'Chen Shun' in some Western catalogs due to dialectal/variant reading of the character 淳 (chun/shun). They are the same person.

claim_text_zh: 陈淳被视为吴门画派中的重要成员，其水墨写意画风对后世文人画有重要影响。
claim_text_en: Chen Chun is regarded as an important member of the Wu School, with his ink-wash xieyi style influencing later literati painting.
review_note: Reception/later art-historical grouping. '吴门画派' is a retrospective label.
